title: Shugo Chara!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Elementary schooler Amu Hinamori seems 'cool and spicy' to classmates but is shy inside. After she wishes for the courage to be her 'would-be' self, three eggs hatch into Guardian Characters, Ran, Miki and Su, who help her transform. She joins the school Guardians to purify X Eggs, people's corrupted dreams, while the Easter Company extracts children's eggs hunting for a wish-granting Embryo.
life_message: Everyone has a true self and dreams worth protecting, and the courage to be yourself grows with friends.

folkways.japan: Amu's 'cool and spicy' public image versus her shy inner self reflects the Japanese contrast of tatemae (public face) and honne (true feelings).

delivery.evidence: Jason Thompson (via Wikipedia) says it centers on self-esteem; the premise itself is a wish to be one's true self.
